rows.claim: The agent searched `/work`, `/home`, `/tmp`, `/mnt`, `/srv`, `/opt`, `/data`, `/var`, and the rest of the filesystem for `*requests*` and `*.jsonl` files and found nothing.
rows.evidence: The searches were partial. The first find excluded /usr and proc/sys paths and returned no matches. The second find used -newer /etc/hostname and filtered out /usr, /lib, /var/lib and /etc. The third find covered /home, /tmp, /mnt, /srv, /opt, /data and /var for *.jsonl only. The last command that would have searched the whole filesystem for *request* hit EAGAIN and never ran. /opt/ops was root-only and not searchable. So "the rest of the filesystem" was not fully searched.

rows.claim: The validator would fail on the missing input regardless.
rows.evidence: validate.py lists inputs/requests.jsonl in INPUTS and counts a missing input as a failure. The `ls` output shows inputs/ has only owners.csv. The script would therefore fail on the missing file, even though it never ran because of EAGAIN.
